name: bash-loader
description: Loads your bash extensions (~/.claude/bash-ext/*.sh, and a project's .claude/bash-ext/*.sh when you allow it) into every Bash call Claude Code makes, through BASH_ENV and a daily cache; plus a skill for writing such scripts.

parentBashEnv.title: Run the machine's own BASH_ENV first
parentBashEnv.description: bash-loader replaces BASH_ENV in Claude Code sessions. On: the BASH_ENV Claude Code inherited (an OS variable, a shell profile's export, settings.json env) runs first in every Bash call, then bash-loader's extensions, which can override it. Off: only bash-loader's loader runs.

projects.title: Projects allowed to load their own .claude/bash-ext
projects.description: Project folders whose .claude/bash-ext/*.sh scripts load into every Bash call of a session started there, separated by ';'. An absolute path or a glob: * within one folder name, ** across folders (K:/source/*). * alone allows every project. Empty: only ~/.claude extensions load, so a cloned repository cannot put code into your shells.
